## Technical Philosophy & Principles
1. **Truth Over Theater**: Every claim corresponds to a verifiable git repository, real hardware schematic, or live production deployment. Zero invented metrics, zero fake awards.
2. **Deterministic Edge Performance**: Systems are built to operate reliably under constrained bandwidth, intermittent connectivity, and strict hardware envelopes.
3. **Hardware-Software Synthesis**: Direct mastery from bare-metal registers and Linux systemd services up to modern reactive browser interfaces.

## Detailed Project Portfolio

### 1. daaym.store — High-End Minimalist E-Commerce Flagship
- **Live URL**: https://daaym.store
- **Repository**: https://github.com/dhyandevp/daaym.store
- **Classification**: Full-Stack E-Commerce, Serverless Architecture, Minimalist Flagship
- **Stack**: Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Firebase Firestore (Mumbai `asia-south1`), Tailwind CSS, Cloudinary CDN.
- **Architecture & Performance**: High-contrast, editorial typography design system avoiding cookie-cutter e-commerce boilerplate. Features high-performance image optimization, sub-second product routing, Firestore inventory synchronization, and real-time mobile inventory management.

### 2. Lid Switch — GNOME Shell Desktop Extension & Systemd Power CLI
- **Live Extension**: https://extensions.gnome.org/extension/11675/lid-switch/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/dhyandevp/lid-switch
- **Classification**: Linux Desktop Environment, Open Source Utility, Systems Engineering
- **Stack**: GJS (GNOME JavaScript), systemd-logind, D-Bus (`org.freedesktop.login1`), Bash.
- **Architecture**: Published on the official GNOME Extensions directory. Provides zero-root user space control over laptop ACPI lid behavior (suspend vs. ignore) directly from the GNOME 45–51+ top panel, eliminating the need to manually edit `/etc/systemd/logind.conf`.

### 3. E-Ration Kerala (ഇ-റേഷൻ) — E-Commerce & Digital Ordering Portal for Kerala Government Ration
- **Repository**: https://github.com/dhyandevp/e-ration-kerala
- **Classification**: Civic E-Commerce, Government Public Distribution System, Digital Ordering Portal
- **Stack**: Next.js 14 App Router, TypeScript, Supabase PostgreSQL, Zustand, Leaflet, Tailwind CSS.
- **Architecture**: A modern e-commerce and digital ordering platform for Kerala Government's Public Distribution System (PDS). Allows cardholders to verify monthly quota entitlements, check live Fair Price Shop inventory, order doorstep delivery, schedule 30-minute pickup slot tokens, and view interactive geolocation maps. Features full bilingual support (Malayalam & English) and WCAG AA accessibility compliance.

### 4. VibeCoding Ball Knowledge — Football Knowledge & Tactical Intelligence Platform
- **Live URL**: https://vibecoding-ball-knowledge.vercel.app
- **Classification**: Web Application, Football Knowledge Platform, Interactive Archives
- **Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vercel Edge.
- **Architecture**: Comprehensive football knowledge website and tactical intelligence platform. Features dynamic question categorization (club history, iconic transfers, Champions League, tactical setups), real-time streak scoring, instant answer verification, deep football archives, and sub-100ms client state transitions deployed on Vercel Edge.

### 5. DrishyaSahayak.ai — Edge Computer Vision Perception Aid
- **Live URL**: https://drishyasahayakai.vercel.app/#home
- **Repository**: https://github.com/dhyandevp/Drishya_Sahayak.ai
- **Classification**: Computer Vision, Assistive Technology, Real-Time Edge AI
- **Stack**: Python 3, OpenCV, Haar Cascade, MobileNetV3, pyttsx3, Linux.
- **Architecture**: Real-time spatial perception and auditory navigation aid for visually impaired users. Processes edge video streams at sub-50ms glass-to-ear latency, computing bounding box centroids for spatial audio panning.

### 6. FaceAttend.ai — Real-Time Biometric Attendance Engine
- **Live URL**: https://faceattendai.vercel.app
- **Repository**: https://github.com/dhyandevp/FaceAttend.ai
- **Classification**: Biometric Security, Machine Learning, Systems Architecture
- **Stack**: Python, OpenCV, Haar Cascade, LBPH, Tkinter, CSV Logging.
- **Architecture**: Contactless face recognition-based attendance engine providing instant identification, liveness anti-spoofing verification, and automatic CSV audit log reconciliation.

### 7. FLARE V2 — Decentralized Disaster Telemetry
- **Repository**: https://github.com/dhyandevp/FLARE_V2
- **Classification**: Embedded IoT, Mesh Telemetry, Emergency Systems
- **Stack**: ESP32, C++ (ESP-IDF/Arduino), LoRa (SX1276), WebSockets, Kotlin Android Companion.
- **Architecture**: Zero-cloud flood and landslide early warning mesh network relaying sensor packets across a 4.2 km test radius without cellular or internet connectivity.

## Quotations & Expert Statements

> "At Wayve Enterprises, our architectural mandate is zero-bloat deterministic software. We do not design for the ideal sunny-day internet; we engineer systems to survive packet drops, thermal throttling, and hardware constraints." — Dhyandev P.
